name: Bureau of Internal Revenue (BIR)
description: The national tax agency. Handles business registration, tax filing, and official receipts/invoices.

name: Social Security System (SSS)
description: Provides social insurance for employees and self-employed individuals.

name: Philippine Health Insurance Corporation (PhilHealth)
description: National health insurance program for employees and self-employed individuals.

name: Pag-IBIG Fund (HDMF)
description: Home Development Mutual Fund: savings and housing loan program for employees and members.

name: Local Government Unit (LGU)
description: Your city or municipality; issues and renews your business permit (Mayor's Permit).

name: Department of Trade and Industry (DTI)
description: Registers business names for sole proprietorships, a pre-registration step before BIR registration.

name: Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC)
description: Registers partnerships and corporations as juridical entities, a pre-registration step before BIR registration.

name: Cooperative Development Authority (CDA)
description: Registers cooperatives, a pre-registration step before BIR registration.
